definitions.gloss: to encourage; to cheer up; to hearten
definitions.explanation: To give someone support, confidence, or motivation.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}を{励|はげ}ます。
{落|お}ち{込|こ}んでいる{彼|かれ}を{励|はげ}ました。
examples.english: I cheered up my depressed friend.

examples.japanese: {応援|おうえん}の{言葉|ことば}で{励|はげ}まされた。
examples.english: I was encouraged by words of support.

notes:
{励|はげ}ます is a transitive verb meaning to encourage.

CONJUGATION (godan verb):
- {励|はげ}ます (dictionary form)
- {励|はげ}まさない (negative)
- {励|はげ}ました (past)
- {励|はげ}まして (te-form)

RELATED FORMS:
- {励|はげ}まされる: to be encouraged (passive)
- {励|はげ}み: encouragement (noun)
- {励|はげ}む: to work hard, strive (intransitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{励|はげ}ます: to encourage someone
